description: 13.06 TERRAIN AND MOVEMENT (Dense): 'INFANTRY/BEASTS/SWARM/MOBILE models can move horizontally through dense terrain features' and 'INFANTRY/BEASTS/SWARM models can move vertically through dense terrain features' — moving ACROSS a dense feature costs a BEASTS model nothing; MOVING VERTICALLY: 'Add the distance moved vertically up ... to any other distance that model has moved' — a BEASTS model that ENDS on a dense feature's top pays the climb. Review of f8d9786 (which made the climb onto any dense piece the move ends in free for BEASTS/SWARM/MOBILE, and pinned a wolf ending inside a Solid wall as legal): the climb onto the piece a move ENDS in exempts only INFANTRY's legacy ground-floor model again; the dense-area difficult-ground exemption (13.06 traversal) stays. Official layout take_and_hold_vs_reconnaissance_1 over the sw11e_s4_command fixture: the player selects the Fenrisian Wolves in the unit list, picks Normal Move and drags the wolf 4" west onto the dense platform generator-11 with the button held: the live drag ruler reads 7.5" (4" + 3.5" climb, green); the drop is staged at that cost. Undo Model, then the wolf is dragged 8.5" west ACROSS the generator to the open ground past it: the ruler reads the raw 8.5" (green), the drop is staged at the raw distance, and End This Unit's Move leaves the wolf there.

Setup: the official layout take_and_hold_vs_reconnaissance_1 (the fixture's own layout is restored in cleanup). generator-11 is a dense 3" platform (25-29 x 41.5-44.5"; 3.5" to the climb model) inside the dense terrain area area-medium-9 (24-30 x 41-45", difficult ground). One Fenrisian Wolf (BEASTS, M10", 40mm base) on the open battlefield east of the area at (31.5", 43"); the pack's other wolves and every other unit but one far-away Boyz mob removed from play.
